'''Karranto Mesa''' was a [[mesa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]. When the planet was in danger of [[Conquest of Makeb|destruction]] in [[3638 BBY]], Karranto Mesa was one of many mesas destroyed in the chaos, exploding shortly before the planet stabilized.<ref name="TOR" />
